; Support, Christmas Service of Remembrance, Hope & Healing for Families and Friends Bereaved by Suicide Drumalane Chapel 13 December 2026 at 4pm Every year since 2003, PIPS Hope & Support welcomes families and friends bereaved by suicide to an Interdenominational Christmas Service of Remembrance, Hope & Healing. It creates a tender and peaceful space to honour those we’ve lost, with moments of comfort through reflections, poems, beautiful music and singing, a candlelight procession and the Memory Tree. This year, the service will be held in St Marys Church of the Assumption, ( Drumalane Chapel) Newry, on Sunday 13th December at 4.00pm. Youth 2000 Christmas Retreat | 11th-13th December 2026. Calling all young people aged 16–35! Join us at the Youth 2000 Christmas Retreat in Newbridge College, Co. Kildare. To register or find out more, visit youth2000.ie or follow @Youth2000Ireland. This is a donation- only event, with free buses available across the country and all meals included. Expect inspiring talks and workshops, Mass, music, prayer, and plenty of opportunities to chill out and meet other young Catholics. Whether you are new to the faith or looking to be refreshed, all are welcome. Trocaire Lent appeal 2027 Trócaire is looking for volunteers to help deliver school talks during our annual Lent Appeal during February and March 2027! We are particularly interested in hearing from people with public speaking experience, especially retired teachers or those who have worked with young people. Volunteers will visit local schools during school hours to share stories of hope, justice, and solidarity from communities around the world. The role involves approximately 1-2 short talks per week during the four-month campaign period. Full training, presentation materials, and ongoing support will be provided.
